US stock earnings outlook weakens｜ETH price around $2666｜I’m watching risk appetite first

My stance is cautious, but I won’t take sell-side earnings forecasts for US stocks as a direct instruction for ETH’s rise and fall. On Binance Square, the #WallStreetEarningsRevisionsTurnBearish headline refers to changes in equity analysts’ earnings expectations. In a Sept. 23 report, Bloomberg cited a Citi US Earnings Revisions Index: the number of analysts lowering forecasts first exceeded those raising forecasts in over 23 weeks. This is the Citi indicator quoted in the report—it is not earnings that companies have already reported as declining, nor is it Ethereum on-chain revenue data. Earlier, on Sept. 4, FactSet noted that S&P 500 constituents’ quarterly EPS estimates had been revised up for the second consecutive quarter. The two observations use different dates and methodologies; you can’t erase one, and you also can’t write “revisions turning negative” as if all companies’ earnings are collapsing.

Why should ETH traders care? If equity earnings expectations weaken and stay weak, traditional risk-asset valuation tolerance may drop, and the same pool of capital may reduce positions in high-volatility crypto assets. But this is a cross-market risk-appetite transmission hypothesis—not proven causality. ETH still has its own drivers: stablecoin usage and DeFi activity, staking and fund subscription/redemption, and protocol progress. These factors could offset or amplify macro pressure. If you tag ETH as “must fall” based only on hot-topic headlines, you ignore timing and capital differences on both sides.

When I checked KuCoin’s ETH/USDT spot, it was about $2666.05, down about 1.78% over the past 24 hours. The range was a high of $2723.44 and a low of $2628.58. The current price hasn’t reclaimed 2700, suggesting risk appetite has not yet given a clear repair signal through price action. However, this drop occurred within a 24-hour window, so it can’t be attributed to one Citi index reading. 2700 is the integer level I watch for a sentiment recovery signal; around 2723 is the high for this leg; and around 2629 is the low that has already formed. If price later holds steadily above 2700 with spot follow-through, my cautious judgment would be invalidated. If it breaks below 2629 again, I’ll first concede that the market is weaker in the short term.

If I were trading for myself, I wouldn’t participate. I would only consider a spot long after conditions are met, and I wouldn’t place high-leverage short positions. Only if two consecutive full 15-minute candlesticks close above 2700, and a pullback to 2685—2700 holds without breaking, while the broader market’s risk appetite does not continue to deteriorate, would I use no more than 0.3% of total capital for the trial order. First target: trim half around 2723. Second target: close the remaining position around 2750. After entry, if the first 15-minute candle pulls back below 2675, I cut the position in half immediately. If it loses 2650, I stop out everything right away and close. If 2629 breaks before entry, this long plan is void. If, two hours after entering, price still can’t push toward 2723, I would also close proactively. If the conditions aren’t triggered, there’s no trade—so I won’t write this “observation” as profit.

The DCAP ETF just launched and immediately turned things up—splitting investors’ money into two halves: one half into the Strategy preferred shares (high dividend + volatility risk), and the other into the Strive preferred shares (low dividend + exposure linked to crypto assets). This bold allocation has drawn plenty of investors who want to “bet on returns” but are afraid it might be too wild. Still, when dividend sources are assets like Bitcoin—which can swing dramatically—can the risk really be kept under control? For BTC/ETH holders looking to buy via ETFs, it may mean more than they think—maybe even less.

Why this news matters
The DCAP ETF’s model is significant because it directly addresses two major pain points in the crypto market: how to earn stable returns amid high volatility, and how to let traditional capital in—and keep it there. Most ETFs today mainly profit by betting on Bitcoin’s price movement. DCAP’s split model, in essence, is playing a “dividend game.” If BTC can truly keep paying dividends, it would be a major positive for the overall valuation of crypto assets. But if BTC can’t even protect its own costs, dividends become empty promises. The success of this setup hinges on whether crypto assets can become “high-quality, consistently paying” assets.

Market impact
- On BTC/ETH prices: In the short term, it may boost sentiment for crypto equities, since ETF innovation often comes with bullish speculation. But the long-term test is whether BTC can actually deliver stable dividends like a mature industry. If BTC keeps surging, dividend pressure will be huge. If BTC crashes, dividends likely can’t even be paid. That means BTC needs to stay above $85K for the DCAP model to look like a can’t-lose business.
- On market structure: These ETFs could accelerate segmentation in the crypto market—some people bet on asset price increases, others bet on dividends. This supply-demand mismatch could feed through to BTC/ETH prices. Simply put: capital is no longer one solid block; it now has more “allocation choices.” That could be a positive for the absolute upside of BTC/ETH, but a potential negative for how fast the upside comes.

Trading/investment approach
💡 Personal view: This DCAP model is a trial run of a “crypto dividend revolution.” If BTC can maintain stable dividend payouts above $80K, it would greatly increase market appeal. But the failure condition is clear: once BTC falls below $78K, the valuation of the Strive preferred shares tied to crypto assets would be cut in half, and the entire ETF’s appeal would collapse instantly. To me, that means the upside potential of this type of ETF is limited unless BTC holds steady above $80K.

Recently, a long-dated Bitcoin options trade has been finalized—this deal won’t expire until 2028. The news frames it as a sign that institutions are growing more confident in the digital-asset market and that the market is becoming more mature. What does that mean? In short, some institutions are willing to play these long-term “bets” through options, not just chase small, near-term gains. It suggests they believe Bitcoin can be around for a long time.

Why is this news important?
The core reason is that, in the past, institutions didn’t dare to touch Bitcoin—an inherently high-risk asset. Now they’re willing to accept long-term risk exposure. Why? The Bitcoin market is slowly taking shape: exchanges are starting to offer options, regulation is gradually loosening, and institutions finally have legal channels to participate. This is similar to the recent approval of spot Bitcoin ETFs—both point to a market that’s improving.

What does it mean for the market?
First, market participants won’t focus solely on short-term volatility; they’re willing to back long-horizon bets. Second, long-dated options can help institutions hedge risk—for example, buying a long-dated put option to protect against Bitcoin falling too much. This makes market tools more diverse.

Market impact
For BTC and ETH prices, the short term may get a sentiment boost, since institutional involvement is typically viewed positively. But the long-term trend still depends on Bitcoin’s own performance—mining costs, and whether new applications can truly emerge. In terms of market structure, it shows Bitcoin transitioning from pure speculation toward a real financial asset. Regarding the regulatory environment, if long-dated options trading develops, it may pressure regulators to provide even more support. On capital flows, you may see more traditional funds moving into the Bitcoin market.

这件事根本原因在于，以前机构不敢玩比特币这种高风险资产，现在他们愿意接受长期的风险敞口。为啥？因为比特币市场慢慢有样了——交易所开始做期权，监管也在慢慢松绑，机构有地方合法地参与进来。这跟最近比特币现货ETF获批有点像，都是说市场在变好。

对市场来说，这意味着啥？首先，市场参与者不再只盯着短期波动，愿意为长期赌局买单。其次，这种长期期权交易能帮机构对冲风险，比如买一个长期看跌期权来防着比特币跌太多。这会让市场工具更丰富。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH价格，短期可能是个情绪提振，毕竟机构入场总是好事。但长期趋势还得看比特币自己表现，比如挖矿成本、新应用能不能出来。对市场格局，说明比特币从纯投机品开始向真正的金融资产过渡。对监管环境，这种长期期权交易如果发展起来，可能会倒逼监管给更多支持。资金流向上，可能会看到更多传统资金往比特币市场里流。

历史参考有点少，因为长期比特币期权交易还是个新鲜事。但可以想想黄金ETF怎么发展的，也是从没人玩到慢慢机构接受。

📰 Could EU energy weapons smash encrypted locks? Quantum computers threaten BTC/ETH

EU regulators have issued a warning: quantum computing technology may break blockchain encryption within the next few years, posing potential risks to Bitcoin and to Ethereum—targeting full deflation by 2029—that are considering technological migration. This isn’t alarmism—today’s quantum computers can already crack the RSA-2048 encryption algorithm within minutes, and both Bitcoin and Ethereum rely on similar cryptographic foundations.

Why is this news important?
Quantum computing is not a sci-fi concept. There are already quantum computers with 53 qubits in development, and they are expected to reach the capability to break elliptic-curve cryptography within 5–10 years. That means Bitcoin private keys and Ethereum account balances could face a risk of being "brute-forced." This threat is critical because it exposes an "Achilles' heel" in the blockchain’s underlying logic: all major public chains are based on mathematical problems, and quantum algorithms can solve those problems. Bitcoin developers are discussing migration to more secure algorithms, but Ethereum’s 2029 deflation goal may be forced to be delayed due to migration costs.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this news will strengthen institutional demand for BTC/ETH as a "digital gold" hedge. With Bitcoin currently at about $83K and Ethereum at about $2,650, their value lies not only in their transaction functions, but also in their security characteristics that are difficult to replicate. If quantum threats intensify, they may drive:
1. Accelerated capital inflows into the crypto market’s "security arbitrage" flows
2. Regulators forcing institutional investors to allocate to quantum-resistant encrypted assets
3. Ethereum developers’ migration roadmap possibly becoming more aggressive than expected

Historically, similar discussions included the 2017 talk of "SHA-256 under quantum computing attack," when the market reaction was muted. But this year, regulators issued an official warning for the first time, meaning awareness of the threat has shifted from academia to the regulatory sphere.

💡 This news means crypto’s "security margin" is being reassessed. If quantum computing achieves breakthrough progress in the next 1–2 years, this judgment will be invalid. With Bitcoin at about $83K and Ethereum at about $2,650, their prices currently include roughly a 5% quantum risk premium. If developers can complete the post-quantum migration before 2025, this premium would disappear.

📰 Why BlackRock’s Collaboration Can Change Digital Asset Custody?

Ondo Network announced a partnership with BlackRock, the world’s largest asset management firm, to develop tokenized smart investment portfolios. This is a big deal for the crypto community, because it means traditional financial giants are finally taking blockchain-based wealth management seriously. In the future, everyday people may not need to buy mutual funds; they can turn their money into tokens and place them on the Ondo platform to enjoy investment strategies similar to those used by BlackRock—liquidity, transparency, and flexibility are all significantly improved. This is an important signal for the development of on-chain finance as a whole.

Why is this news important?
The core reason is that digital asset custody has been far too unreliable—most DeFi platforms carry a high risk of rug pulls, while traditional financial institutions are still clinging to old methods. The Ondo + BlackRock partnership implies: 1) BlackRock recognizes blockchain’s potential as an investment tool; and 2) tokenized assets can finally connect seamlessly with the traditional financial system. This is completely the opposite of the earlier situation where Buffett famously came out against Bitcoin—top-tier institutions are now stepping in personally to play with digital assets.

Market impact
In the short term, BTC and ETH may see a sentiment rebound thanks to this news. After all, BlackRock’s move is essentially “backed by facts,” directly giving the market a reassurance. In the medium to long term, tokenized assets will bring more mainstream capital into crypto, especially benefiting major coins like BTC. A historical reference is the period around the introduction of ETFs in 2021—capital inflow curves were almost perfectly overlapping. This time the pattern is similar, but goes even deeper.

Trading outlook
💡 In this leg of the market, if BTC can hold steady at the key level of $82,000, it may be able to kick off a new round of upside. 📰 Why is Ark Invest moving a $10 billion fund on-chain?

Ark Invest is giving its $13 billion ARK Venture Fund an Ethereum “doppelgänger,” allowing investors to use blockchain-issued certificates to custody this investment portfolio. The portfolio includes unicorns such as OpenAI and Stripe. Created in 2022, the fund’s on-paper value has surged from $20 to more than $60. This is data as of September 23, 2026, according to Bitcoin.com.

Why is this news important?
This isn’t something Ark Invest suddenly decided to do to “play with” blockchain. It has already been using on-chain approaches for alternative asset allocation for a long time. This time, it’s taking the fund itself on-chain. In essence, it’s providing investors with a more transparent—potentially more efficient—digital asset that can also be split and rebalanced on demand. That means that in the future, institutional allocation of alternative assets may see blockchain evolve from a tool into core infrastructure. In plain terms, this is another example of institutional investors embracing on-chain assets—far more than just retail traders chasing a coin, because it directly reflects the stance of professional capital.

Impact on the market
In the short term, market sentiment for BTC and ETH will likely be stirred. After all, ARK is a well-known institution in the space. When it puts money into going on-chain, it’s essentially stamping a big label on those sectors. In the long run, if this model works, it could push more traditional funds to consider on-chain allocations, which would be positive for the entire crypto asset ecosystem. Historically, whenever institutions adopt innovative ways to allocate assets, it ultimately boosts the industry’s imagination—for example, with the early Bitcoin ETFs. What’s different this time is that it’s putting the fund itself on-chain, not putting a single product on-chain.

Trading/strategy outlook
With actions like this, it’s likely that ARK is bullish on the long-term development of the crypto industry. But in the short term, they may be more focused on how the sectors they’re heavily invested in—such as AI and fintech—perform. My personal view is that if ETH can hold steady around the $2,700 level, this behavior would be a positive feedback loop for on-chain assets. It would mean that professional money using on-chain tools for allocation is feasible. If ETH breaks below that level, or if regulation suddenly tightens for on-chain asset management, then this logic carries risk. If XRP also benefits from this on-chain asset management model, it would imply that RWA (real-world asset) tokenization could accelerate—but the correlation would be much weaker.

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月二十五日凌晨，以太坊现货价格报二千六百八十五点四美元，过去数小时在二千六百六十至二千七百美元区间内反复震荡。从小时K线来看，ETH在触及二千七百零一美元高点后回落，随后在二千六百八十五美元附近获得支撑并企稳。整体走势与比特币保持高度联动，但以太坊在回调过程中展现出相对抗跌的特征。

近期以太坊从高位回落的主要驱动因素同样来自宏观层面。美国十年期国债收益率突破百分之五点一五，市场对美联储十月加息二十五个基点的预期概率升至百分之七十，流动性收紧预期压制了整个加密市场的风险偏好。然而，以太坊现货ETF近期保持正向净流入，累计流入超过一点零四亿美元，表明机构资金对以太坊的中长期价值依然看好。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线报二千六百八十六点五美元，价格紧贴均线运行，显示短期方向尚不明朗。二十五小时均线位于二千六百七十六点三美元，对价格形成下方支撑。九十九小时均线在二千七百一十一美元，构成上方阻力。价格目前夹在短期均线与长期均线之间，等待方向选择。

KDJ指标中K值七十四点六六、D值七十二点六九、J值七十八点六零，三线均位于中高位区域，短期存在一定回调压力但整体偏多。量化因子统计显示十五个因子中七个做多、七个做空、一个中性，多空力量完全均衡。复合指标信号偏空，但做多胜率达百分之八十八点九，高于做空胜率百分之六十八点四，暗示多头一旦发力将具有更高的可靠性。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前的市场情绪可以用谨慎乐观来概括。链上数据显示，新的鲸鱼实体在近期回调中累计增持约三万二千枚ETH，价值约八千五百六十万美元。与此同时，交易所流通供应比例下降至百分之十二点三，意味着市场上的即时抛压显著减少，有利于价格在中长期获得支撑。

🚨 Risk Management: The Secret Weapon for Success and Longevity in the Crypto Market! 📈💡
​In the fast-paced world of trading, the difference between a trader who achieves sustainable profits and one who loses their capital in just a few days isn’t "luck" or "complex indicators"—it’s discipline and risk management.
​Here are 4 golden rules followed by top traders to protect their assets:
​1️⃣ The 2% Rule (2% Rule)
​Don’t risk more than 1% to 2% of your total portfolio in a single trade. Preserving capital is the first step toward making profit.
​2️⃣ Stop-Loss is a lifeline
​Setting your exit point before opening a trade separates professionals from gamblers. Don’t let your emotions drive you to “hope” for the price to bounce back while it’s dropping.
​3️⃣ Risk-to-Reward Ratio
​Always aim for at least a 1:2 ratio. With this ratio, even if only 50% of your trades are winners, you can still exit the market with excellent overall profit.
​4️⃣ Avoid Revenge Trading
​When you lose a trade, fix your mistake by closing your screen and taking a break. Trying to recover the loss suddenly the same day often leads to even bigger losses.
​💡 Always remember: trading is a long marathon, not a short-run sprint. Sticking to the plan beats emotions every time!
​👇 Share your thoughts in the comments: what’s the most important rule you rely on in your daily trading?

U.S. 30-Year Treasury Yield Rises to 5.47%｜ETH Still Near 2686｜I’ll First Manage Volatility, Not Chase Shorts

My stance is cautious and more defensive, but I won’t mechanically translate rising yields into “ETH must fall.” The Binance Square hot list is currently discussing #US30YearYieldHighestSince2004. The U.S. Treasury Department reported on September 24 that the fixed-term yield on 30-year Treasuries is 5.47%, higher than 5.40% on the 23rd; the 10-year yield rose from 5.11% to 5.18%. This is the official end-of-day data. It’s not the same sampling time as the intraday 5.44% mentioned in the press release, so you can’t mix them into the same market move. Binance News is also watching the selloff in long bonds, indicating this isn’t simply a sentiment topic from the crypto圈.

When long-end rates rise, the transmission to ETH has two layers: first, the risk-free yield is higher, increasing the opportunity cost of holding volatile assets; second, when financing and discount rates rise, overvalued risk assets tend to shrink positions together. But that’s only a pressure channel, not proof of immediate selling. ETH is influenced both by macro risk appetite and by on-chain activity, net subscriptions/redemptions of spot ETFs, and leverage in derivatives. If ETF demand continues absorbing supply and on-chain funds stay active, the headwind from rates could be partially offset. So I won’t short ETH nakedly based on a single yield figure, nor will I treat “highest since 2004” as a specific downside-magnitude forecast for ETH.

The market has reacted, but it’s not a one-way collapse. At the time of writing, KuCoin spot ETH/USDT is around $2686.59, with a 24-hour high of $2705.79 and a low of $2628.58—about a 0.47% gain versus roughly $2700 this time yesterday. In other words, after long-bond yields rose, ETH remained below the previous 2700-level and fluctuated repeatedly; what we can currently confirm is that it hasn’t reclaimed the highs yet—not that macro news has already caused sustained downside. Next, I’m watching two conditions: whether there can be consecutive daily closes above 2706 and then a successful retest that doesn’t break; and if it loses 2670 again, whether it rapidly slides toward around 2628. If yields fall while ETH is still breaking down, the issue may be more than just macro. If yields keep rising and ETH holds above 2706, then my defensive judgment would be weakened.

If this were my own trade: I’m not participating now. On direction, I’ll only keep conditional small-position spot longs and no leveraged shorts. Only if two complete 15-minute candles close above $2706, and then the subsequent pullback holds within the 2695—2706 range, will I try a long position with 0.3% of total funds; then cut it in half at 2725, and liquidate the remaining near 2745. After entry, if a 15-minute close drops back below 2685, I’ll cut the position in half first; if it touches 2670, I’ll stop out the entire position and close. If before that trigger the price breaks below 2628 first, this plan is immediately invalidated—I won’t catch a falling knife during the downswing. My position size is so light because macro yields and ETH’s short-term price don’t correspond one-to-one; any data release or rate fluctuation could cause a breakout to fail. I’ll verify the Treasury yield data and the complete ETF data again tomorrow morning. Until there’s evidence of improvement occurring in sync, discipline matters more than guessing direction.

#US30YearYieldHighestSince2004 #ETH

美债30年收益率升至5.47%｜ETH仍在2686附近｜我先防波动不追空

我的态度是谨慎偏防守，但并不把利率上行机械地翻译成“ETH必跌”。币安广场热榜正在讨论#US30YearYieldHighestSince2004。美国财政部9月24日公布的30年期国债固定期限收益率为5.47%，高于23日的5.40%；10年期由5.11%升至5.18%。这是官方日终数据，与新闻稿提到的盘中5.44%不是同一个取样时点，不能混写成同一笔行情。币安News也在关注长债抛售，说明这不是单纯的币圈情绪话题。

长端利率抬升，对ETH的传导有两层：一是无风险收益率更高，持有波动性资产的机会成本上升；二是融资与贴现率上升时，高估值风险资产容易一起收缩仓位。但这只是压力渠道，并不是即时卖盘的证明。ETH既受宏观风险偏好影响，也受链上活动、现货ETF净申赎和衍生品杠杆影响。若ETF需求持续吸收供给、链上资金活跃，利率逆风也可能被部分抵消。因此我不会凭一条收益率数据裸空，更不会把“2004年以来高位”当作ETH的具体跌幅预测。

市场已经有反应，但还不是单边崩盘：写稿时KuCoin现货ETH/USDT约2686.59美元，24小时高2705.79、低2628.58，较24小时前约涨0.47%。换句话说，长债利率上行后，ETH仍在前一轮2700关口下方反复，当前能确认的是高位未站稳，而不是宏观消息已经造成持续下跌。接下来我看两个条件：2706上方能否连续收盘并回踩不破；若再失守2670，是否快速滑向2628附近。利率若回落而ETH仍破位，说明问题可能不只在宏观；利率继续上行而ETH站稳2706，则我偏防守的判断被削弱。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与，方向上只保留条件式小仓位现货多单，不做杠杆空单。只有两个完整15分钟K线收在2706美元上方，随后回踩2695—2706区间守住，才以总资金0.3%试多；2725减半，2745附近平掉剩余。入场后若15分钟收盘跌回2685下方先减半，触及2670全部止损平仓；触发前若先跌破2628，本计划直接作废，不在下跌中接飞刀。仓位这么轻，是因为宏观收益率与ETH短线价格并非一一对应，任何一次数据或利率波动都可能令突破失败。明早再核对财政部收益率与ETF完整数据，证据没有同步改善之前，守纪律比猜方向重要。

#US30YearYieldHighestSince2004 #ETH

📰 Why Bitcoin Is Experiencing the First Ever Bear Market That Doesn’t Break the Cost Basis?

Glassnode has found that, for the first time in Bitcoin bear markets, the price has not fallen below the “realized price.” The realized price is a key metric used to assess whether Bitcoin holders are in profit or loss. In this bear market, while BTC has fluctuated, it has remained above the breakeven point for the profitability/loss of all historical holdings. This is a major signal for market maturity, investor confidence, and overall resilience—especially for participants in the crypto market who should pay close attention.

Why is this news important?
At its core, this means Bitcoin is shifting from being merely a price-speculation asset to a form of “digital gold” with intrinsic value support. The realized price is often viewed as the market’s “landmine line.” Once it is broken, large numbers of long-term holders tend to cut losses, triggering a liquidity spiral. But this time, that landmine line has not been breached, suggesting that:
1. The holder base is more diversified. It includes not only short-term speculators, but also long-term allocation needs such as insurance funds and family wealth.
2. Funds and institutions are starting to evaluate Bitcoin holdings using the “net asset value (NAV) approach” rather than the “market cap approach,” reducing the pressure to liquidate.
3. Bitcoin’s realized price itself has risen significantly—from the $60K area to the current $84,350.66—meaning long-term holders’ breakeven points have increased materially.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this reinforces the narrative of BTC as a “safe haven,” especially in a broader environment of global interest rates returning to normal. But the more far-reaching effect is that:
- Institutional allocation may more strongly favor adjusting positions using the “realized price anchoring method.”
- When evaluating Bitcoin’s value, regulators may refer to the realized price rather than price fluctuations.
- The trigger conditions for the next downturn may shift from “falling below the realized price” to “falling below the $70K key support level.”

There aren’t many historical reference examples, but similar phenomena have occurred in the 2015–2016 Bitcoin bear market, alongside changes to ETF rules and institutional capital entering the market. The current environment is more complex, but losing the landmine line does not necessarily mean the decline is over—it means the logic behind the drawdown must be rebuilt.

Trading/positioning ideas
💡 This bear market suggests Bitcoin has formed a “cost-basis moat.” As long as it does not fall below the $80K range, downside momentum should be significantly weakened. Because the realized price at $84,350.66 is far above the typical bottom of past bear markets, any panic selling would likely trigger institutional “catch-up” buying. If the Federal Reserve continues to cut rates in September more than expected, this view would be invalid.

Group: [点击进入玖玖的粉丝群](https://app.binance.com/uni-qr/YXXQJrPb)

How intense this UNI run-up has been—now the pullback is just as frightening.
Over the past 30 days, UNI climbed more than 114% at one point, rising from around $4 all the way to above $10. Then today it abruptly fell 11.8%, briefly dipping to around $9.

📉 After doubling in a month, a correction at this scale isn’t really surprising.
What’s more worth watching is: is this drop just profit-taking, or is the uptrend starting to loosen?
Right now, UNI’s price is still clearly higher than most of the past few months, which suggests the capital that chased earlier has already built up substantial unrealized gains.
The faster it rises, the easier it is for profit-takers to cluster.

Once the market pulls back, earlier buyers are very likely to choose to cash out first—so you often see the situation of: “chase like crazy when it’s up, and sell together when it’s down.”
🔥 But this UNI rally isn’t purely hype.

One key logic is that the fee mechanism of the Uniswap protocol has changed.
In the past, UNI was more often treated as a governance token. As the protocol’s fee mechanism gradually rolled out, some of the income generated by Uniswap began to connect with the UNI token’s supply mechanism.

In simple terms:
The more active Uniswap trading is → the more protocol revenue is generated → part of that revenue is used for token burning → circulating supply decreases.
This is also one of the reasons the market has started to revalue UNI.
But here’s the issue...

⚠️ Improving fundamentals doesn’t mean the price won’t fall.
Especially after the past month saw a gain of over 100%, a large amount of short-term profit capital has piled up in the market. And during this pullback, derivatives trading volume is clearly higher than spot, suggesting leveraged funds are amplifying volatility. If long leverage gets too high, once UNI breaks a key level, it could trigger a chain reaction of liquidations—leading to “drop a little → get liquidated → keep falling.”

📰 The Fed just said it wants to make stablecoin rules so complicated—so what is the real intention behind the GENIUS Act?

The Fed has just proposed new regulations for banks issuing stablecoins, requiring that each $1 token must be backed by $1 in reserves, with redemption time limits of no more than two business days. Issuers that fall short on capital may be forced to liquidate. This new rule directly builds on the U.S. law, the GENIUS Act, which was just passed this summer.

South Korea is one of the most active cryptocurrency trading markets globally. When domestic capital exits → sell pressure on BTC.

Why is this news important?
The Fed’s move this time is not typical—it concretely operationalizes stablecoin oversight for banks, not just at the principle level. Over the past few years, the stablecoin market has grown wildly, with “money-like” stablecoins such as USDC being pegged to the dollar—yet no one has truly regulated whether there is actual gold-and-cash backing. The Fed’s new rules require that reserve assets must be cash, U.S. Treasuries, or other highly liquid assets, and prohibit using cryptocurrencies as collateral. This means that going forward, for banks to issue dollar stablecoins like USDC, they must truly have $1 in cash reserves for every $1.

The root cause is that when crypto surged in 2020, stablecoin supply also skyrocketed, which raised concerns among regulators. Now, with the U.S. passing the GENIUS Act specifically to govern digital currencies, the Fed’s new rule is essentially the concrete implementation of the Act—embedding stablecoin regulation into the existing bank regulatory framework. It fits within the broader trend of tighter regulation and is more systematic than the earlier fragmented pilot approaches taken by different countries.

Market impact
In the short term, the new rules may dampen speculative sentiment in the stablecoin market. Companies like Circle, which rely entirely on crypto-collateralized stablecoins, have already seen their stock prices react ahead of time. But the direct impact on BTC and ETH may be limited. On one hand, stablecoins are an important component of liquidity in crypto markets—if overly strict regulation causes stablecoin issuance to shrink, it could reduce trading depth across the market. On the other hand, stablecoins like Tether, which are suspected of having insufficient reserves, may be pushed out by stricter oversight—ironically making cryptocurrencies more of a trusted store-of-value option. A similar historical reference is the U.S. crackdown on crypto-trading platforms by banks in 2014; while it triggered panic then, in the long run it promoted compliant development.

Trading/strategy thoughts
💡 In the short term, the new stablecoin rules mean higher compliance pressure, which may accelerate some capital shifting from higher-risk crypto assets toward more reliable stablecoins—but this shift won’t happen overnight. If, in the next two weeks, BTC falls below the key support level of $82K, that would indicate the market is more sensitive to stablecoin market turmoil than expected, and this judgment would be invalid. 📰 刚说美联储稳定币新规要搞这么复杂，现在GENIUS法案的真正意图到底是什么？

美联储刚提出银行发行稳定币的新监管草案，要求每1美元代币必须有1美元储备担保，赎回时限不超过2个工作日，资本不足的发行方可能被强制清算。这个新规直接用上了今年夏天刚通过的美国法案GENIUS Act。韩国是全球加密交易最活跃市场之一，本土资金抽离→BTC抛压

为什么这条新闻重要？
美联储这次出手不一般，把银行发行稳定币的监管从原则层面具体化。过去几年，稳定币市场野蛮生长，像USDC这种货币型稳定币和美元挂钩，但没人管它到底有没有真金白银支撑。美联储新规要求储备资产必须是现金、国债、高流动性资产等，禁止使用加密货币作为抵押品。这意味着以后银行要发行像USDC这样的美元稳定币，就得真正准备1美元的现金。这件事的根本原因在于，2020年加密货币暴涨时，稳定币规模也疯涨，引发了监管机构的担忧。现在美国通过了GENIUS法案专门管数字货币，美联储的新规就是具体落实法案内容，把稳定币监管纳入现有银行监管体系。它处于监管收紧的大趋势中，比之前各国零散的试点办法更系统。

对市场的影响
新规短期会打压稳定币市场的投机情绪。像Circle这种完全依赖加密货币抵押稳定币的公司股价已经提前反应了。但这对BTC和ETH的直接影响有限。一方面，稳定币是加密市场流动性的重要组成部分，如果监管太严导致稳定币发行量萎缩，可能会降低整个市场的交易深度。但另一方面，像Tether这种被怀疑有储备不足问题的稳定币，可能会被更严格的监管逼退，反而让加密货币成为更受信任的价值储存手段。历史类似事件参考的是2014年美国对银行加密货币交易平台的监管加强，那次虽然也引发了恐慌，但长期看促进了合规发展。

操作思路
💡 短期看，稳定币新规意味着合规压力上升，可能会加速一部分资金从高风险加密货币流向更稳妥的稳定币，但这个转变不会突然发生。如果未来两周BTC跌破$82K这个关键支撑位，说明市场对稳定币市场动荡的敏感度超预期，这个判断作废。本文无任何项目方赞助，作者不持有文中提及标的

📰 Are Bitcoin miners getting addicted to hoarding coins? What’s behind CleanSpark’s 10,500 BTC stockpile?

CleanSpark, a Bitcoin mining company, says it has more than 10,500 BTC in reserves that it has not sold or pledged. This figure reflects the inventory it has accumulated over years of mining—not production from the past month. This milestone shows CleanSpark’s strategy of keeping a large amount of the Bitcoin it mines. It’s big news for the crypto market, but what does it actually mean?

Why is this news important?
More and more miners are stockpiling coins, which suggests they believe Bitcoin is worth more. CleanSpark’s inventory of over 10,500 BTC is cumulative data, meaning their cost basis for holding those coins may not be too high. As the time horizon stretches, the potential profit could be more substantial. Why disclose this number now? Perhaps because the Bitcoin price is nearing the cost range they were buying at while accumulating, or they want to build investor confidence. This reflects a broader increase in the industry’s confidence in holding Bitcoin, especially among leading mining firms.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this news acts as a positive sentiment catalyst for BTC. If miners generally increase their hoarding rate, it reduces the amount of Bitcoin circulating in the market, similar to the effect of Bitcoin’s supply reduction. In the medium term, this is Bitcoin’s narrative advantage—miners’ reserve behavior validates Bitcoin’s value-storage attribute. Historically, after the 2008 financial crisis, miners’ coin-hoarding proportions also rose sharply. This suggests that as long as BTC holds above 85K, the miners’ hoarding trend may continue to strengthen. The impact on ETH is relatively indirect, but the overall narrative boost could still benefit the “big-bread” chain ecosystem.

Trading ideas
💡 In the short term, BTC is at least likely to hold steady around the 85K level. The miners’ hoarding behavior supports the bullish logic. If BTC breaks below 82K and miners start selling the hoarded Bitcoin, this view would be invalidated. In other words, before BTC breaks above 90K, miners’ actions may remain an important support factor.

📰 矿商囤币成瘾？CleanSpark 10,500 BTC 库存背后是啥？

CleanSpark 这家比特币矿企说，它没卖掉、没抵押的比特币储备超过 10,500 枚了。这个数字反映的是他们多年来挖矿攒下的库存，不是最近一个月的产量。这个里程碑展示了 CleanSpark 保留大量挖出比特币的策略。这对加密货币市场是个大新闻，但具体意味着什么？

为什么这条新闻重要？
矿商囤币越来越多，说明他们认为比特币更值钱。CleanSpark 超过 10,500 枚的库存是累积数据，这意味着他们的囤币成本可能并不高，时间维度拉长后利润会更可观。为什么现在突然公布这个数字？可能因为比特币价格接近他们囤积时的成本区间，或者想给投资者信心。这反映了行业整体对持有比特币的信心增强，尤其是头部矿企。

对市场的影响
短期内，这个新闻给 BTC 带来正向情绪催化剂。如果矿商普遍增加囤币率，会减少市场上的比特币流通量，类似比特币减产效应。中期看，这是比特币的叙事优势——矿工的储备行为验证了比特币的价值存储属性。对比历史上，2008 年金融危机后矿工囤币比例也曾大幅上升。这意味着，只要 BTC 价格维持在 85K 上方，矿工囤币趋势可能继续强化。对 ETH 的影响相对间接，但整体叙事对大饼链的带动效应会存在。

操作思路
💡 BTC 短期至少在 85K 位置稳固，矿工囤币行为支撑看涨逻辑。如果 BTC 下破 82K 并且矿工开始抛售囤积的比特币，这个判断作废。意味着在比特币价格突破 90K 之前，矿工行为会是重要的支撑因素。

The common theme: most of these are relatively small-cap projects tied to major narratives — AI, DeFi, infrastructure, storage, Ethereum L2s and zero-knowledge privacy.

My stance is to verify in advance—I don’t chase. The accurate trending topic on Binance Square is #ETHBreaksAbove$2,700, and the page’s six-hour hot search also lists ETH as a fast riser. This indicates rising attention, not necessarily sustained capital inflows. In a Binance News official market update, it states that at 16:43 UTC on September 24, ETH was at 2702.61 USDT, up 1.43% over 24 hours. But when I rechecked KuCoin spot while writing, it was around $2692.32; over the past 24 hours, the high was 2705.79 and the low 2628.58. The quotes differ slightly between the two platforms, but they both point to one thing: 2700 was broken through, and right now it hasn’t firmly held above it. The hot-list headline marks a historical moment and shouldn’t be mechanically turned into a bullish signal for the present.

Why is this integer level worth watching? Near breakouts, you often get a cluster of take-profit orders, chase orders, and stop-loss orders. A brief wick above the level can trigger all three types of trades at the same time—prices look lively, but the direction may not have been chosen yet. ETH is also jointly influenced by interest-rate expectations, positioning in risk assets, and on-chain activity. A price-touch alert can’t prove ETF net subscriptions, and it can’t prove that the Ethereum Foundation has released a new official upgrade. In this round, I also checked the Foundation announcements, the SEC, and the Federal Reserve pages; I couldn’t find a first-hand document that directly attributes this push to a newly issued formal policy or a mainnet event. If macro or regulatory news appears later, it should be re-verified based on its publication time, not fitted into today’s causal chain through speculation.

The market’s current outcome is: it rebounded from the 24-hour low of 2628.58 back above 2690, but it left a high near 2705.79 that needs to be confirmed again. If the bulls truly have continuous backing, at minimum they should close continuously above 2700, and when it pulls back it shouldn’t immediately fall back below the integer level. If price repeatedly spikes through 2700 and then quickly falls back below 2680, I’ll treat it as a fake-breakout risk—not as a reason to keep emphasizing the hype. If it breaks below 2628.58 again, the short-term judgment of “the repair continues” is invalid. Conversely, after holding 2700, you still need to watch the actual sell pressure in the 2720–2740 range; don’t pre-assume it will move straight higher.

If this were my own trading: I wouldn’t participate. I would only do conditional spot long setups with zero position size. I’d enter with at most 0.3% of total funds only if two complete 15-minute candlesticks close above 2706; after that, if it comes back to 2695–2706 and holds, I enter. Then I’d cut the position in half at 2725, and fully close the remaining position at 2745–2750. After entering, if the 15-minute candles close below 2685, I’d reduce by half first; if it touches 2670, I’d stop out and close the trade. If I haven’t entered and price first breaks below 2628.58, the plan is canceled. If there’s back-and-forth scanning around 2700, I’ll continue to stay in cash—no using leverage as a substitute for evidence, and I won’t write an untriggered plan as an executed trade.

Source: Binance News official ETH price-touch update, KuCoin ETH/USDT spot; also cross-checked public pages from the Ethereum Foundation, the Federal Reserve, and the SEC. #ETHBreaksAbove$2,700 #ETH

📰 Just said regulation is the focus, and now Trump himself has stepped in to buy crypto?

A couple of days ago, people were still talking about how the U.S. government should regulate cryptocurrencies. The result? The boss, Trump, bought first himself. In an executive document, he disclosed that in July he bought several thousand shares of Strategy’s stock. The company has a bit to do with blockchain—so it’s fair to say it’s caught some of the policy heat. For the market, this counts as an unexpected development, especially since politicians and cryptocurrencies usually have little overlap.

Why is this news important?
Put simply: in the past, the government regulated crypto; now it’s regulating—so to speak—its own people. Behind this are a few reasons. First, with cryptocurrencies being so hot right now, even the boss might see it as an investment opportunity. Second, the U.S. government is also thinking about how to make crypto regulation work in practice. The boss buying shares himself is like throwing a card on the table for the market: “We’re not completely against it either.” Looking at it alongside other recent events, previously some people said the U.S. government would ban cryptocurrencies. Now that the boss has bought in himself, at least it suggests things aren’t that extreme.

Impact on the market
For BTC and ETH, this is basically a neutral piece of news. In the short term, it may affect sentiment, but it won’t change the bigger direction. Even if Trump bought tens of thousands of shares, it isn’t significant compared to the overall amount of market capital. Still, the symbolic meaning is huge. Changes in the regulatory environment mean crypto might not be immediately and fully suppressed—but it also won’t be lifted to the sky. Similar cases aren’t common historically, but one reference is that many policies in the past started by testing in the private sector and eventually turned into official actions.

Trading ideas
💡 I think this is more of a sentiment indicator. If Trump’s investment pans out, it could encourage more political figures to pay attention to cryptocurrencies. But be careful: if Strategy’s stock price falls, this behavior will look rather foolish instead. That implies there may be bullish sentiment in the short term—but that conclusion is invalid if the U.S. stock market suddenly blows up.

简单说，以前是政府管加密货币，现在管管自己人。这件事背后是几个原因：第一，加密货币现在这么火，连老板都可能觉得这是个投资机会；第二，美国政府其实也在想怎么把加密货币监管管活，老板自己买股票，等于给市场打了张牌——"我们也不是完全反它"。跟近期其他事件关联看，之前还有人说美国政府要封杀加密货币，现在老板自己买了，至少说明没那么极端。

📰 Why do the Federal Reserve’s new stablecoin regulations have to be so complicated? What is the real intent of the GENIUS Act?

The Federal Reserve has just announced three new rules for stablecoin issuers: they must hold sufficient reserves, contribute the required capital, and obtain approval before they can legally issue stablecoins. This is part of the GENIUS Act framework that was passed not long ago. In plain terms, it’s about setting rules for the “money-printers” in crypto (stablecoins) to prevent them from becoming the next trigger point for a financial crisis.

Why is this news important?
The Fed’s move isn’t baseless. In recent years, tragedies like Terra’s stablecoin collapse made regulators realize that if these “digital cash” aren’t backed by real assets, the financial system could be pulled under at any time. The core goal of the GENIUS Act is to make stablecoins behave more like bank deposits—backed by tangible, real-world assets—so they can earn the trust of institutional investors and everyday people. These new rules mean regulators are shifting from “fixing problems after the fact” to “preventing problems in advance,” which is a milestone change for the entire DeFi industry.

Impact on the market
In the short term, the market may see temporary volatility. On one hand, expectations of compliance could drive some speculative capital into stablecoin projects that have been certified by regulators. On the other hand, some niche or high-risk stablecoins may face survival pressure. In the long run, this new regulation will reshape the stablecoin industry landscape: leading players will gain a larger share of the market, and the situation of driving out “good” coins with “bad” ones should improve. Historically, after regulators tighten oversight, compliant assets often benefit from structural opportunities.

💡 These new rules mean improved stability for the market, but there will be growing pains in the short term. I believe stablecoin projects that meet the new requirements (such as large players like USDC—USD-pegged—and eUSDC—EUR-pegged) will benefit, but the total size of the stablecoin market may shrink in the short term. If a major exchange suddenly abandons issuing its own stablecoin, or if the GENIUS Act is indefinitely stalled in Congress, then this assessment would be invalid.

📰 为什么美联储的稳定币新规要搞这么复杂？GENIUS法案的真正意图到底是什么？

美联储刚宣布要给稳定币发行方套上三个新规矩：必须留足准备金、交足资本金，还得通过申请才能合法发行。这是落实不久前通过的GENIUS法案框架的一部分。说白了，就是想给币圈那些印钞机（稳定币）立规矩，防止它们变成下一个金融危机的引爆点。

为什么这条新闻重要？
美联储这次出手不是空穴来风。过去几年，像Terra这种稳定币崩盘的惨剧，让监管机构意识到，这些"数字现金"背后如果没点真金白银，金融系统可能随时被拖下水。GENIUS法案的核心目的，就是让稳定币变得像银行存款一样，有实实在在的资产支撑，这样才能赢得机构投资者和普通民众的信任。这条新规意味着监管层从"事后补救"变成了"事前预防"，对整个DeFi行业来说，这是里程碑式的转变。

对市场的影响
短期内，市场可能会出现短暂的波动。一方面，合规化预期会让部分投机资金流入经过监管认证的稳定币项目；另一方面，一些小众或高风险稳定币可能面临生存压力。长期来看，这条新规将重塑稳定币行业格局，头部玩家会获得更大的市场份额，而劣币驱逐良币的局面会得到改善。从历史看，每次监管收紧后，合规的资产反而会迎来结构性机会。

💡 这次新规对市场意味着稳定性的提升，但短期内会有阵痛。我判断，符合新规的稳定币项目（比如美元锚的USDC、欧元锚的eUSDC这类大厂）会受益，但整个稳定币市场的总规模短期内可能收缩。如果出现大型交易所突然放弃发行自有稳定币，或者GENIUS法案被国会无限期搁置，这个判断作废。

📰 Why is Enso taking on all ether.fi RWA execution? Reaching 100+ assets instantly is just the start?

Suddenly, this blockchain technology platform called Enso is tightly tied to ether.fi—it handles all real-world asset (RWA) execution for the ether.fi App. That means ether.fi users can directly, through Enso, instantly open access to 100+ types of assets that have blockchain attributes (such as real estate and stocks), without having to bounce around to find other providers. The story was just reported by Crypto Briefing, possibly aiming to move the diversity of cryptocurrencies into the hands of everyday people faster.

Why is this news important?
At its core, the ambition in crypto is to achieve a “seamless connection” with the real world. Previously, doing RWA was too troublesome—you had to deal with an entire lineup of NFT and DeFi “experts.” Now, with Enso providing a one-stop service, it’s like installing a high-speed highway for this pathway. What does that mean for the industry? It’s racing to solve the biggest pain point: “crypto assets are too complex.” If regulators keep making progress (for example, the U.S. actually approves Crypto ETFs), then services that package real-world assets onto the blockchain will become the biggest traffic-driving sector in the future. Recent news about the SEC possibly setting up an investment company focused on crypto points in the same direction: making crypto more convenient and more compliant.

Impact on the market
In the short term, the sentiment impact on BTC/ETH may not be significant—after all, this is just a side note in a bull market. But in the long run, if Enso’s move helps ether.fi attract more users (especially users from traditional finance), it will indeed strengthen the narrative that “crypto is the future new frontier for investing.” If the regulatory environment is genuinely loosened, tools like this can accelerate the adoption of crypto assets and could even raise overall market risk appetite. Historically, similar events—like FTX’s early push into derivatives—started small and then unleashed enormous energy. But there’s a key difference this time: Enso is a new player. It’s unclear whether they can deliver the kind of extreme user experience that established incumbents can. If they mess up, it could turn into “too much thinking, not enough doing.”

Approach
💡 I think this news is neutral-to-slightly-positive, but it’s important to keep the key points in view. If, over the next few weeks, you can see ether.fi user numbers rise noticeably, or if the number of RWA asset categories keeps exploding, it could boost overall market sentiment. But【failure condition】: if regulators suddenly change course—for example, if the U.S. cracks down hard on RWA compliance—then this logic falls apart. In simple terms: it depends on whether this service can truly solve users’ pain points, rather than just staying in press releases.

📰 为什么 Enso 要包揽 ether.fi 所有 RWA 执行，100+资产瞬间触达只是开始？

Enso 这个区块链技术平台，突然跟 ether.fi 紧密绑一块了——它包办了 ether.fi App 所有现实世界资产（RWA）的执行工作。这意味着 ether.fi 用户能直接通过 Enso，秒开 100 多种带区块链属性的资产（比如房产、股票那种），不用再跳来跳去找其他服务商。这事儿在 Crypto Briefing 上刚报道，可能是为了把加密货币的多样性，更快地塞进普通人手里。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事根本原因，在于加密世界想跟现实世界“无缝对接”的野心。以前搞 RWA 太麻烦，得跟 NFT、DeFi 各路神仙轮番打交道，现在 Enso 一站式服务，等于给这条通路装了个高速公路。这意味着啥？行业在拼命解决“加密资产太复杂”这个最大痛点。如果监管继续给力（比如美国真批准 Crypto ETF 了），这类把现实资产打包上链的服务，就是未来流量最大的赛道。跟最近 SEC 要给 Crypto 单开投资公司的新闻，都指向同一个方向：让加密更方便、更合规。

对市场的影响
对 BTC/ETH 短期情绪影响可能不大，毕竟现在是牛市里的小插曲。但长期看，如果 Enso 这波操作能帮 ether.fi 吸到更多用户（尤其是传统金融用户），确实会强化“加密是未来投资新大陆”的叙事。监管环境要是真的松绑，这类工具能加速加密资产的普及，甚至可能推高整个市场的风险偏好。历史上类似事件，比如 FTX 早期做衍生品，也是从小处着手，最后爆发出惊人能量。但这次有个关键点：Enso 是新势力，不知道能不能像老牌玩家那样，把用户体验做到极致。如果他们搞砸了，可能就是“想太多，做得少”。

操作思路
💡 这条新闻我觉得是中性偏暖，但必须踩住点。如果未来几周能看到 ether.fi 用户量明显增长，或者 RWA 资产种类继续暴增，可能会带动大盘情绪。但【失效条件】如果监管突然变脸，比如美国严查这类 RWA 合规性，那这个逻辑就作废了。简单说：看这个服务能不能真正解决用户痛点，而不是只停留在新闻稿里。

以太坊市场深度分析：机构资金持续流入，多空拉锯进入关键阶段

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月二十四日凌晨，以太坊现货价格报两千六百七十六美元，过去数小时在两千六百四十四美元至两千七百零六美元区间内窄幅震荡。从小时级别走势来看，以太坊整体呈现弱势整理格局，价格多次尝试突破两千七百美元关口未果。

以太坊近期走势与比特币高度相关，同样受到美国国债收益率飙升的压制。但以太坊展现出一定的韧性，在两千六百四十美元附近获得较强买盘支撑。从机构资金流向来看，九月二十三日以太坊现货ETF单日净流入超过一亿零四百万美元，此前一周更是录入了两亿七千万美元的大额流入，机构配置需求依然旺盛。

值得关注的是，四家新的机构实体地址近期从中心化交易所累计提取约三万两千枚以太坊，显示大户正在减少交易所持仓，倾向于中长期持有。同时一家大型资产管理公司在以太坊网络上推出了代币化风投基金，进一步拓展了以太坊在合规金融产品领域的应用场景。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七日均线报两千六百七十一美元，二十五日均线报两千六百七十三美元，两者几乎重合且位于当前价格下方，形成密集支撑区。九十九日均线位于两千七百零九美元，明显高于当前价格，构成较强的上方阻力。短中期均线粘合，表明市场正处于方向选择的关键节点。

MACD指标显示，DIF线为负六点八零，DEA线为负十点八九，柱状图为四点一零。MACD虽然仍处于零轴下方，但柱状图连续五个周期保持正值并持续扩大，显示空头力量正在逐步衰竭，多头动能稳步增强。按照当前收敛速度，MACD有望在未来数小时内完成零轴下方的金叉并向上突破。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为五十八点五八，十二周期RSI为五十二点四九，二十四周期RSI为四十八点六四。各周期RSI均处于五十附近的中性区域，既不超买也不超卖，表明价格处于均衡状态，后续方向取决于外部催化剂。

布林带指标显示上轨位于两千七百零三美元，中轨位于两千六百七十二美元，下轨位于两千六百四十二美元。价格在中轨与上轨之间运行，带宽持续收窄至约六十美元，为近期最低水平，预示大幅波动即将到来。KDJ指标中K值为六十九点零三，D值为六十五点二三，J值为七十六点六五，三线维持多头排列但上升动能有所放缓。

抛物线SAR指标报两千六百一十二美元，远低于当前价格，确认中期多头趋势未变。超级趋势指标报两千七百一十四美元，位于价格上方形成短期压力。ATR指标报二十六点四七，显示当前波动率处于适中水平。

三、市场情绪分析

从量化因子统计来看，十五个因子中有六个发出做多信号，八个发出做空信号，一个为中性，空方略占上风。综合指标给出做空信号，胜率为百分之六十八点四二，整体信号偏向谨慎。但值得注意的是，做多信号的胜率高达百分之八十八点八九，说明一旦多头信号触发，其可靠性非常高。

链上数据方面，虽然机构持续增持，但也不能忽视潜在的风险信号。一家大型实体近期向机构交易台转入了四万两千枚以太坊，同时智能.money地址向中心化交易所存入超过四千枚以太坊，这些动作可能暗示部分大户正在准备获利了结。此外近期某加密赌场遭遇七百万美元的安全事件，被盗资产被兑换并整合为以太坊，可能在短期内造成一定的负面情绪。

宏观层面，美国国债收益率走高和原油价格上涨对以太坊等风险资产构成系统性压力，美联储鹰派立场进一步加大了市场不确定性。但从长期来看，以太坊网络在代币化金融产品和合规应用方面的持续扩展，为其价值提供了坚实的基本面支撑。

综合来看，以太坊短期将在两千六百四十美元至两千七百一十美元区间内继续震荡整理。建议投资者密切关注布林带收窄后的突破方向，以及本周五一百五十亿美元期权到期对市场的影响。若价格有效突破两千七百一十美元，有望打开上行空间至两千八百美元一线，反之若跌破两千六百四十美元支撑，则可能回测两千六百美元整数关口。

热门代币速览

XAI，当前价格零点零一一四五美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之四十六点七九，成交量爆发式增长至四百五十万美元，但RSI已达九十四点五的极端超买水平，需警惕回调风险。

LSK，当前价格零点四一二美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之三十五点一三，突破前期震荡区间上沿，量能配合良好，短期动能充足。

BROCCOLI714，当前价格零点零三零四九美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之三十二点五一，社区活跃度大幅提升，资金持续流入推动价格走高。

📰 Why has BlackRock’s BUIDL fund suddenly surged?

BlackRock’s BUIDL tokenized fund’s assets under management exceeded $552 million on September 22, after issuing tokens to qualified institutional investors via the Securitize platform. This figure should not be conflated with the stablecoin supply offered to retail users, but it does signal that the world’s largest asset manager has effectively entered the blockchain investment space.

Why is this news important?
At its core, this is a signal that traditional finance giants are rushing into the key market of crypto asset management. BlackRock’s choice of BUIDL instead of an ETF suggests that what they see is not short-term price volatility, but the certainty of long-term growth driven by the blockchain’s underlying technology. Since the fund is only available to institutions, it indicates that BlackRock believes the risks are still too high at this stage, and they prefer to use an “institution-only” threshold to filter for projects that can survive through market cycles.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this may boost institutional investors’ demand to allocate to crypto assets. However, when it comes specifically to BTC/ETH, the impact could be uneven. Tokens held in the BUIDL fund may create ongoing buy-side momentum. Still, because the fund’s size is only about 0.2% of the entire crypto market, it is unlikely to drive a breakout of the $116.48K–$116.48K range. In the long run, if this model is replicated, it could lead to a “public-offering level” blockchain asset category, changing the current supply-demand dynamics that are largely driven by VCs and retail investors.

💡 I believe this expansion in scale is a milestone toward the normalization of blockchain asset allocation. If broader regulatory cooling occurs within the next month, this trend could accelerate. If the Fed unexpectedly hikes rates in October, this assessment would be void.

📰 为什么BlackRock的BUIDL基金突然暴增？

BlackRock的BUIDL代币化基金资产管理规模在9月22日突破5.52亿美元，通过Securitize平台向合格机构投资者发行。这个数字不能和面向零售用户的稳定币规模混为一谈，但意味着全球最大资管公司已经实质性进入区块链项目投资领域。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这本质是传统金融巨头抢滩加密资管核心赛道的信号。BlackRock选择BUIDL而非ETF，意味着他们看中的不是短期价格波动，而是区块链底层技术驱动长期增长的确定性。基金仅面向机构，说明BlackRock认为目前阶段风险过高，但愿意用"机构专属"的门槛筛选出真正具备穿越周期的项目。

对市场的影响
短期看，这会提振机构投资者对加密资产的配置需求。但具体到BTC/ETH，影响可能存在分层。对BUIDL基金持仓的代币，会形成持续买入动力，但考虑到基金规模仅占整个加密市场约0.2%，不足以推动大盘突破$116.48K-$116.48K区间。长期来看，如果这个模式被复刻，可能会分化出"公募级"区块链资产类别，改变目前仅靠VC和散户推动的供需关系。

💡 我认为这次规模扩张是区块链资产配置正规化的里程碑，如果未来一个月出现更大范围监管降温，这个趋势会加速。如果10月美联储意外加息，这个判断作废。

一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至北京时间二零二六年九月二十四日，以太坊当前报价二千六百四十四美元，过去二十四小时内下跌约百分之二点九。价格从二千六百九十三美元高位回落，最低触及二千六百美元整数关口附近，随后在二千六百四十至二千六百五十美元区间内窄幅波动。从小时级别K线来看，经历一波快速下杀后成交量明显放大，第二小时成交额达到六千五百九十三万美元，随后逐步回落至不足一千万美元，显示抛压正在减弱但买盘同样谨慎。

从均线系统来看，当前价格已经跌穿所有主要均线。七日均线约为二千六百六十二美元，二十五日均线约为二千六百七十六美元，九十九日均线约为二千七百零四美元，价格运行在全部均线下方，空头排列格局清晰。布林带下轨约为二千六百四十四美元，价格几乎触及下轨，中轨位于二千六百七十三美元，带宽持续扩张中，暗示价格波动可能加剧。

二、技术指标深度解读

MACD指标方面，MACD线约为负十五点九二，信号线约为负十四点三三，柱状图约为负一点五八，空头动能仍在持续放大，短期内看不到明显的底部信号。RSI指标显示六周期RSI约为三十一，已经接近超卖区域，十二周期RSI约为三十四，二十四周期RSI约为三十八，短周期指标率先进入低位区域，存在技术性反弹的可能。

KDJ指标显示K线约为四十六，D线约为四十七，J线约为四十四，三线在中性区域下方运行，尚未形成金叉。威廉指标WR约为负五十三，较前期有所改善。随机RSI指标从高位快速回落至十八附近，显示短期严重超卖。综合十五个量化因子来看，八个发出做空信号，六个发出做多信号，一个中性，空头占比百分之五十三点三，相比比特币的空头占比略低，显示以太坊的技术面虽然偏空但存在更多分歧。

三、市场情绪与宏观环境分析

以太坊近期面临的最大压力来自大户获利了结。数据显示某大型持有者近期抛售了四万二千零五个以太坊，价值约一点一一九亿美元，这是导致价格快速下跌的直接原因。同时中东地缘政治紧张局势和美联储鹰派预期共同压制了风险资产的整体表现。如果价格跌破二千五百三十六美元的关键支撑位，可能触发约四点六九亿美元的连环清算，这将进一步加剧下行压力。

不过积极因素同样存在。以太坊现货ETF在九月二十三日录得一点零四六亿美元的净流入，显示机构资金仍在持续布局。同时以太坊生态在量子安全领域取得重要进展，Vitalik Buterin宣布了DAISUGI v0.1后量子测试网，使用SPHINCS哈希签名方案，展现了以太坊社区在技术前沿的持续投入。短期来看，以太坊可能在二千六百至二千七百美元区间内震荡筑底，关注二千五百三十六美元支撑位的有效性。

Brooklyn man sent to prison for 12 years for stealing $16M in a Coinbase phishing scheme

A Brooklyn resident is headed to prison for 12 years after pleading guilty to scamming nearly 100 Coinbase users out of roughly $16 million dollars, a New York district attorney said Wednesday.

Ronald Spektor, 23, ran a phishing and social engineering scheme for over a year, convincing his victims that they had been hacked and that they should transfer funds to accounts he controlled, said Eric Gonzalez, a New York district attorney.

Social engineering scams topped crypto threats in 2025 and are getting worse this year. WhiteBIT said nearly 41% of all crypto securityincidents last year involved fraudsters deceiving victims. Earlier this month, a 22-year-old Singaporean pleaded guilty to a network of criminals that netted $245 million mostly from social engineering scams. A Chainalysis report noted that criminals were increasingly targeting individuals rather than infrastructure.

“Today’s sentencing holds the defendant accountable for a brazen, long-running social engineering scam that amounted to a digital robbery of nearly 100 victims,” Gonzalez said. “Our Virtual Currency Unit painstakingly pieced together the digital proof that identified the defendant behind this sophisticated scheme, followed the money that he stole and compiled iron-clad evidence against him.”

The attorney general’s office has also ordered Spektor to forfeit cash, cryptocurrency and personal property with an estimated value of more than half a million dollars and make restitution of almost $16 million.

The investigation into Spektor’s criminal activities revealed he laundered the digital assets by swapping them across multiple crypto exchanges and consolidating them at “cash-out points.” He then converted them into other cryptocurrencies and placed bets, before converting them into cash with which he purchased gift cards or additional digital assets.#BTC #ETH #bnb $BTC

According to a message from Binance Square, the hacker stole about $351.6M from Bitget. So far, they have cashed out 67,982 ETH on Ethereum and other EVM chains, worth approximately $183M. This suggests the hacker is converting illegal proceeds into mainstream digital assets—possibly in preparation for long-term holding or transferring funds. It can create short-term disruptions to crypto market fund flows and the ETH price.

Why is this news important?
This theft exposes a weak spot in DeFi protocols: smart contract security. The hacker chose to operate on an EVM chain rather than a regular chain, potentially because networks like Ethereum offer relatively faster transaction speeds and better privacy. More deeply, it reflects the “borderless gold” nature of crypto assets— even if funds originate from illegal sources, they tend to flow into the market naturally. It’s similar to discovering your safe was emptied: the money may not disappear, it may just change form and blend into the broader market.

Market impact
In the short term, ETH may face downward pressure. With ETH currently trading at $2,676.9, a $183M sell-off could weigh on prices if concentrated trades occur. However, considering ETH’s total supply and circulating supply, this cash-out represents only about 0.69% of the total circulating amount, so the market’s capacity to absorb it is relatively strong. What matters more is where this capital goes next: if it’s used for long-term holding or cross-chain transfers, it could provide potential support for ETH; if it’s used for leveraged trading or further attacks, the risk would be much greater.

Trading approach
I believe that in the short term, ETH will most likely trade in a range of $2,676.9–$2,700. If the hacker continues to slowly monetize funds (rather than fully liquidating at once), the price impact should be manageable. title: BTC现货ETF再吸2.43亿、ETH流出1.18亿：高利率下机构为何只偏比特币？
subTitle:
今天亚洲盘，比特币在约8.44万–8.45万美元附近窄幅震荡，以太坊约2687–2689美元一线；Alternative.me恐惧贪婪指数仍报71「贪婪」。更扎眼的不是涨跌点数，而是资金账本：据链上观察@lookonchain（Blockchain.News转述），9月25日口径下，10只美国现货比特币ETF录得净流入约2186枚BTC、约2.4265亿美元，其中贝莱德iShares Bitcoin Trust约+1135枚BTC、约1.26亿美元，持仓升至约768285枚BTC（约852.8亿美元）；同期9只以太坊现货ETF净流出约29764枚ETH、约1.1816亿美元，贝莱德以太坊相关产品约-6352枚ETH、约2522万美元。一句话：高利率环境里，机构钱在「分流」——偏BTC、减ETH。

【发生了什么】
价格侧：BTC自本周高点约8.74万美元回落后，在约8.32万–8.45万区间反复争夺（Proactive/DigitalToday）；ETH跟跌后小幅反弹，但仍弱于BTC资金叙事。资金侧：周三现货BTC ETF曾单日净流入约3.47亿美元、连续五日合计约26.5亿美元（Proactive）；今日口径则是BTC续吸、ETH转出。情绪侧：恐惧贪婪指数持平71，价格回调了，情绪还没真正恐慌。

【为什么是今天】
主线不在某个山寨币故事，而在「宏观贵钱」遇上「机构选边」。
1. 美债收益率高位：10年期周四一度约5.196%（约2007年以来高位），30年期约5.48%（Proactive），长端利率抬升等于给风险资产加资金成本。
2. 加息预期被重新定价：CME FedWatch显示10月加息概率约75%、12月约59%（DigitalToday）；美联储9月16日已加息25个基点至3.75%–4.00%目标区间。
3. ETF成了「用脚投票」的窗口：同样是现货通道，BTC继续吸金，ETH遭赎回，说明机构仓位优先级在分化。

宏观把钱变贵时，最先被挑出来的往往不是「要不要加密」，而是「加密里先保哪一个」。

【ETF分流怎么读】
▸ BTC净流入约2.43亿：机构仍在用合规通道加仓比特币，不是单纯合约炒作。
▸ ETH净流出约1.18亿：以太坊现货通道出现赎回压力，短期叙事弱于BTC。
▸ 贝莱德等巨头仍在BTC侧加码：大资金偏好流动性更深、宏观对冲叙事更清晰的资产。

别把「BTC流入」直接翻译成「马上再冲新高」。流入可以托住回调，也可以只是减缓下跌速度；若利率继续抬、风险偏好再收缩，ETF买盘也可能阶段性放缓。

【这不是单边牛市口号】
从更长一点的骨架看：BTC本周曾冲到约8.7万美元附近，整体仍是强势后的回撤整理。另据市场整理，美国现货比特币ETF持仓平均成本约在8.2万美元附近（Bitcoin.com口径）；现价略高于该参考位，有助于解释为何机构仍愿在回调中接货——但这是持仓成本参考，不是铁底保证。
- 若8.4万附近反复守住，且BTC ETF净流入连续维持，偏「机构接盘+去杠杆后的修复」；
- 若失守关键支撑、同时ETH流出扩大、美债收益率再创新高，叙事会从「分流」滑向「全面风险下降」。

【散户更该盯的三件事】
1. ETF流向，不是口号：BTC现货ETF是连续流入还是突然翻转为流出；ETH是流出收窄还是扩大。
2. 利率总闸门：10年期美债是否稳在高位；10月FOMC前加息概率是否继续抬升。
3. 自己的仓位结构：半山腰最贵的不是踏空，是用高杠杆去赌「机构买了就一定马上拉升」。方向可以错，仓位不能错。

【一句话】
今天的主线不是「山寨又讲了一个故事」，而是：美债高利率压估值的同时，机构用ETF把选票投给了比特币——约2.43亿流入对约1.18亿流出。价格标签在8.4万–8.5万，真正的考卷在利率路径和资金分流能否持续。

translatedData.title: 🔵 Ethereum is back in the spotlight! Is there a surprise coming? 👀
translatedData.subTitle:
While many people’s attention is focused on Bitcoin, Ethereum continues to attract the interest of investors and developers.
But what is it that makes ETH one of the most prominent currencies worth following?
Ethereum is not just a digital currency; it’s a network that supports smart contracts, decentralized applications, and decentralized finance (DeFi) projects.
As Layer 2 solutions evolve and institutional interest grows, the factors that influence demand for the network and its currency are changing.

translatedData.content:
For large holders, self-custody is the core of asset security.

An exchange may compensate you once, twice, or even many times.

But the moment there is a single hack that causes losses exceeding what the platform can cover, it becomes a sea of corpses and blood.

So what truly matters is never “how much the exchange promises to pay,” but rather not exposing all assets to a single point of failure.

Large assets should be distributed across multiple cold wallets; for day-to-day use, reconfigure only a small amount of hot wallets. The exchange should hold only the necessary trading funds.

Store in layers: cold wallets, hot wallets, and exchanges.

An exchange’s advantage is convenience, but its drawback is concentration.

ARK Invest Tokenizes ARK Venture Fund on Ethereum via Securitize

ARK Invest, the disruptive-innovation investment manager founded by Cathie Wood, announced on 24 September that it has tokenized the $ARK Venture Fund (ARKVX) through Securitize Corp. (NYSE: SECZ), bringing the actively managed fund onchain for the first time.

Tokenized interests in the fund are available initially on Ethereum, with Securitize handling the onchain issuance and the investor experience. The move puts one of $ARK’s flagship strategies onchain and reflects a shared conviction between the two firms that tokenization can modernize how investment products are accessed, owned, and managed.

What the fund holds
ARKVX is an actively managed, closed-end interval fund that invests across private and public companies aligned with disruptive innovation. Its portfolio includes stakes in OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, and Databricks, among others, so eligible investors who access the fund through Securitize gain exposure to leading private technology companies through blockchain-based infrastructure. Fund holdings are subject to change.

$ARK, which Wood founded in 2014 and is headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, focuses solely on disruptive innovation, targeting large-scale opportunities across artificial intelligence, robotics, energy storage, and blockchain technology. As an interval fund, ARKVX offers limited liquidity through periodic repurchase offers, and its shares are not listed on an exchange; the tokenized interests represent a stake in the fund itself rather than direct ownership of the underlying companies.

Why ark is going onchain
“Tokenizing the ark Venture Fund puts our conviction in the evolution, if not revolution, of capital markets into practice,” said Cathie Wood, $ARK’s founder, CEO and chief investment officer. “Making the ark Venture Fund available onchain is a natural extension of our mission to democratize access to technologically enabled disruptive innovation.”

The Fed Proposes Stablecoin Regulation Draft｜Banks Still Need to Apply and Hold Adequate Reserves｜ETH at 2675—don’t run ahead

My stance is neutral to cautious: this is a worth-watching regulatory development, but it is not “bank-issued stablecoins have already been approved,” nor is it a reason for ETH to necessarily surge tonight. A #FedProposesRulesForBankIssuedStablecoins has appeared on Binance Square’s trending list. I looked up the Fed’s original September 24 announcement: the Board is seeking comments on two proposals—one would apply to payment stablecoin issuers regulated by the Fed, requiring fully qualified reserve assets to adequately support issuance, along with capital, risk management, and reserve custody requirements; the other would set up a dedicated application process for regulated banks seeking to issue payment stablecoins, with application materials including a business plan and financial information. The comment period runs for 60 days after the notice is published in the Federal Register. The keywords are “proposal,” “request for comments,” and “application”—not that the rules are already effective, nor that any bank has already been granted a license.

Why does this matter for the crypto market? If the final rules establish an enforceable framework for banks to issue and redeem stablecoins, the compliant pathway for fiat to enter on-chain payments could become clearer. Exchanges, wallets, and DeFi could then potentially gain more stable USD settlement tools. But the first beneficiaries would be qualifying issuers and use cases. ETH, as a native asset on a particular network, only becomes directly transmissible when real issuance, transfers, and usage ultimately land on Ethereum and are converted into ongoing on-chain fees and demand. The draft proposal does not designate Ethereum as the only chain. The issuance scale, actual rollout timing, chain selection, and fee model are still uncertain. On the same day, Fed Governor Barr also emphasized the importance of redeeming at par in a timely manner during stressful periods—reminding me that the most core risk of stablecoins is not the marketing slogan, but reserves, redemption rights, and operational resilience.

The market has not provided clear confirmation of “regulatory good news leading to an immediate ETH rally.” When I checked KuCoin’s ETH/USDT spot price while writing, it was around $2675.5; over the past 24 hours, the high was about $2705.79 and the low about $2628.58, a move of roughly -0.38%. Price briefly probed near $2700 and then retreated, so you can’t directly attribute this fluctuation to the Fed announcement. What I’m watching now is whether $2705–$2710 can be reclaimed and held, with support levels at around $2650 and $2628. These are merely execution watch levels, not prices guaranteed by policy. If the draft is later modified significantly, rollout is blocked, or institutions ultimately choose other chains and there is no growth in Ethereum-based stablecoin activity, I would overturn the view that ETH could indirectly benefit. If price breaks below $2628 and stays there, my short-term recovery plan would also fail.

If I were trading this myself, I would not enter. I would only keep a small position for a spot long. I must wait for two full 15-minute candlesticks to close above $2710, then confirm a pullback of $2695–$2710 that does not break, and also see that the news is not corrected by official sources. Then I would enter with no more than 0.3% of total capital; I’d cut the position in half at $2735, and close the remaining position at $2760–$2770. After entry, if a 15-minute candle closes back below $2680, I’d cut the position in half; if it hits $2650, I would fully close immediately with a hard stop. If before triggering those conditions price breaks below $2628, I would cancel the entire plan. Without these conditions, I’d rather miss the move than use leverage to bet on a draft policy text that is still under consultation.

#FedProposesRulesForBankIssuedStablecoins #ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

美联储提出稳定币监管草案｜银行发币仍需申请与足额储备｜ETH在2675我不抢跑

我的态度是中性偏谨慎：这是值得盯的制度进展，但不是“银行稳定币已经获批”，也不是ETH今晚必涨的理由。币安广场新热榜出现#FedProposesRulesForBankIssuedStablecoins。我查到美联储9月24日原始公告：理事会征求两项意见，一项针对受美联储监管的支付型稳定币发行人，拟要求合格储备资产足额支持，并提出资本、风险管理及储备托管要求；另一项设立受监管银行申请发行支付型稳定币的专门程序，申请材料包括商业计划与财务信息。意见期是《联邦公报》刊登后60天。关键词是“提案、征求意见、申请”，不是规则已生效，更不是任何银行已获许可证。

这件事为什么和加密市场相关？如果最终规则为银行发行与赎回建立可执行框架，法币进入链上支付的合规路径可能更清楚，交易所、钱包和DeFi都可能获得更稳定的美元结算工具。但受益对象先是符合条件的发行人和使用场景，ETH作为某条网络的原生资产，只有真实的发行、转账、应用使用最终落在以太坊，并转化为持续的链上费用和需求，才谈得上更直接的传导。规则草案并未指定以太坊为唯一链；发行规模、实际落地时间、选链、收费方式都还不确定。美联储理事Barr同日也强调压力期按面值及时赎回的重要性，这提醒我：稳定币最核心的风险并非宣传语，而是储备、赎回权与运营韧性。

市场并没有给出“监管利好立刻拉升ETH”的清晰确认。我核对KuCoin ETH/USDT现货写稿时约2675.5美元，过去24小时高2705.79、低2628.58，变动约负0.38%。价格曾上探2700附近又退回，不能把这段波动直接归因美联储公告。眼前我看2705—2710是否被重新站稳，下方看2650与2628一带；这些只是执行观察位，不是政策能保证的价格。如果后续草案被明显修改、落地受阻，或机构最终选择其他链且以太坊链上稳定币活动没有增长，我会推翻“ETH可能间接受益”的判断；若价格跌破2628并持续收在下方，短线修复计划同样失效。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只保留小仓现货试多。必须等两根完整15分钟K线收在2710上方、回踩2695—2710不破，并看到消息没有被官方修正，才用总资金最多0.3%入场；到2735减半，2760—2770平掉余仓。若入场后15分钟收回2680以下先减半，触及2650硬止损全部平仓。若触发前先跌破2628，取消整套计划。没有这些条件，我宁可错过，不用杠杆押注尚在征求意见的制度文本。

#FedProposesRulesForBankIssuedStablecoins #ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

As of 9:00 a.m. Beijing time on September 25, Ethereum spot prices are at $2,683. Over the past few hours, prices have consolidated narrowly between $2,676 and $2,698. From the hourly K-line chart, the most recent five K-lines show a pattern of small fluctuations. The bodies are relatively short, and the upper and lower wicks alternate, indicating the market is in a wait-and-see state.

Regarding the moving average system: the 7-day moving average is at $2,689, slightly above the current price and acting as short-term resistance. The 99-day moving average is at $2,713, about $30 above the current price, forming a medium-term upward target. Worth noting, the 7-day exponential moving average at $2,687 is crossing above the 25-day exponential moving average at $2,684, suggesting a short-term “golden cross” is about to form.

For the Bollinger Bands: the upper band is $2,711, the middle band is $2,676, and the lower band is $2,641. The standard deviation is only 1.79, indicating volatility has dropped to an extremely low level—suggesting a major move could be imminent at any time. On the Relative Strength Index (RSI): the 6-period RSI is 56.5, the 12-period RSI is 53.2, and the 24-period RSI is 49.7. Compared with Bitcoin, Ethereum’s RSI is more neutral. Values across the cycles hover around 50, suggesting the market has not yet formed a clear directional consensus—but it also means there is ample room for both upward and downward movement.

For the Stochastic indicator: the K value is 68.8, D is 69.7, and J is 66.9. The three lines are sticking together near 70, with no clear direction. Compared with the earlier pullback from higher levels, the indicator has stabilized. If the K line crosses back above the D line, it will confirm a short-term rebound signal.

The Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) indicator shows positive changes. The MACD line at 0.45 has crossed above the zero line, while the signal line at -2.96 is rapidly converging. The Williams %R is at -25.9, placing it in the neutral-to-strong zone. It has not entered the extreme overbought/oversold ranges. The Random Relative Strength Index is 86.78—high, but not yet at an extreme overbought level. Compared with Bitcoin’s 96.65, this is healthier.

Ethereum’s market currently shows strong supply and demand. On the supply side, exchange balances have been declining steadily. At the same time, there are 1,680,000 ETH waiting to be staked. 以太坊市场深度分析：技术面温和向好，多重风险仍需警惕

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月二十五日上午九时，以太坊现货价格报二千六百八十三美元，过去数小时在二千六百七十六美元至二千六百九十八美元之间窄幅整理。从小时K线来看，最近五根K线呈现小幅波动格局，实体较短，上下影线交替出现，显示市场处于观望状态。

均线系统方面，七日移动均线报二千六百八十九美元，位于当前价格略上方，形成短期阻力。二十五日均线二千六百七十七美元则提供下方支撑，两条短期均线趋于粘合，方向选择迫在眉睫。九十九日均线位于二千七百一十三美元，距离当前价格约三十美元，构成中期上行目标。值得关注的是，七日指数移动均线二千六百八十七美元正在上穿二十五日指数移动均线二千六百八十四美元，短期均线金叉即将形成。

布林带上轨二千七百一十一美元，中轨二千六百七十六美元，下轨二千六百四十一美元。价格在中轨上方运行，带宽持续收窄至近期低位，标准差仅一点七九，表明市场波动率降至极低水平，大幅行情一触即发。抛物线指标位于二千六百三十五美元，远低于当前价格，维持中期看多格局。

二、技术指标解读

相对强弱指数方面，六周期为五十六点五，十二周期为五十三点二，二十四周期为四十九点七。与比特币相比，以太坊的RSI更为中性，各周期数值均在五十附近徘徊，表明市场尚未形成明确的方向性共识，但也意味着上行和下行空间都较为充裕。

随机指标K值六十八点八，D值六十九点七，J值六十六点九，三线粘合于七十附近，方向不明朗。与前期KDJ从高位回落的走势相比，当前已趋于稳定，若K线重新上穿D线将确认短线反弹信号。

移动平均收敛发散指标呈现积极变化。MACD线零点四五已上穿零轴，信号线负二点九六正在快速收敛，柱状图三点四保持正值。这是以太坊短期技术面中最值得关注的积极信号，MACD零轴上方运行通常对应一段上行趋势。不过柱状图数值较前期略有缩小，需观察后续能否重新放大以确认动能。

威廉指标负二十五点九，处于中性偏强区域，未进入超买超卖极端区间。随机相对强弱指数八十六点七八，位于高位但尚未达到极端超买水平，相比比特币的九十六点六五更为健康。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前呈现供需两旺的格局。供给端方面，交易所余额持续下降，同时有一百六十八万枚以太坊等待质押，质押需求远超解除质押申请量，表明长期持有者信心坚定。大型机构近期从交易所提取超过八千五百万美元的以太坊，并额外购入一亿一千九百万美元，积极吸收市场流通供给。

现货ETF方面，以太坊ETF连续录得净流入，累计超过一亿零四百万美元。ARK投资在以太坊网络上推出代币化风投基金，进一步丰富了链上生态。纽约证券交易所与Blockchain.com签署合作备忘录，探索代币化美股和ETF的全天候链上交易，以太坊作为主要智能合约平台将直接受益。

风险因素同样不容忽视。近期多起交易所和安全事件导致超过三亿五千八百万美元被兑换为以太坊，形成潜在的抛售压力。宏观层面，美国国债收益率飙升和油价上涨持续压制风险偏好。此外，一名场外交易鲸鱼在近期价格反弹后抛售超过一亿一千一百万美元的以太坊，显示大户在关键阻力位存在获利了结意愿。

综合来看，以太坊技术面温和向好但缺乏强驱动，基本面供需结构健康但短期面临宏观和抛压风险。建议关注二千七百一十美元布林带上轨突破情况，若放量突破则打开上行空间至二千七百五十美元区域，反之若跌破二千六百四十美元下轨支撑则需防范进一步回调。

【ETH is choosing a direction—this time there’s a fundamental difference】

Over the past week it’s risen by nearly 10%, and now it’s stuck around 2680. In the last 24 hours it’s barely moved, yet trading volume has expanded—both longs and shorts are holding their breath.

From the daily chart, 2750 is a tough obstacle, while 2580 is the line in the sand. The 4-hour chart has formed a converging pattern, and the 1-hour chart keeps probing around 2680. This range-bound consolidation has been going on for almost a week—it's time to pick a direction.

But what’s really interesting isn’t the technicals.

Within the past 48 hours, two pieces of news came out that, when connected, tell a clearer story: ARK Invest and Securitize tokenized a venture fund that includes investments in OpenAI and Anthropic, prioritizing deployment on Ethereum; meanwhile, Bitwise’s research found that when the market was cut roughly in half, institutions chose to hold BTC, and some also set exit conditions for ETH and SOL.

What does that mean? Institutions are starting to treat ETH as an “asset that can be used in a serious way,” not merely as chips for “trade it and get out.”

From a business-logic perspective: if the RWA tokenization track works, demand for Ethereum as an institutional-grade settlement layer would increase significantly. If ARK’s case succeeds, more traditional asset managers will likely follow—this isn’t just a concept; it’s a real cash-flow logic.

Who will be affected? The group involved in asset management, custody, and fiat on/off-ramping will, sooner or later, be swept through by this wave of change.

My take: in the short term, technical pressure is on the downside; selling pressure above 2750 isn’t light, and if it breaks below 2580 the structure is damaged. But if volume supports the move—or if market expectations for ETFs heat up—the probability of an upside breakout is higher.

Can this actually become reality? What do you think? #ETH #加密分析 #ONDO #Market Insight

最近一周涨了将近10%，现在卡在2680附近。24小时几乎没动，成交量却放大了——多空都在憋着一口气。

Bonk Guy Responds to Allegations of Manipulation and Says He Has No Intention to Sell PONS and USELESS

According to Odaily, as relayed by Odaily Planet Daily, Bonk Guy has responded to recent questions about his holdings. First, a clarification of boundaries is needed: this article is based on media reports and does not directly verify his original posts or detailed on-chain address data. Therefore, the contents should be understood as a secondary record of the party’s public statements, not an independent audit conclusion.

Rumors in the market claim that Unipcs does not sell, which may suggest market making or fund manipulation, implying the stance is untrustworthy. Bonk Guy challenged this inference and redirected the dispute back to the holding period and valuation thresholds.

What can be confirmed is that Bonk Guy said he chooses to hold long-term high-conviction assets. His reasons come from experience in the previous cycle: in that cycle, the market caps of some Meme coins exceeded $1 billion; strong Meme coins reached more than $4 billion to $5 billion; and excellent protocols reached more than $5 billion. He also believes this cycle may be more active. According to his disclosed figures, the market value of PONS and USELESS in his holdings is about $400 million and $270 million, respectively, which has not reached $1 billion. Therefore, he chose to continue holding and emphasized that he has different investment time horizons. The key point is not an immediate judgment of “up or down,” but that his selling conditions are tied to historical ranges, conviction levels, and his personal cycle.

Logically, this response attempts to untangle two layers of misunderstanding. First, equating “not selling” directly with manipulation is not supported by a complete evidence chain. A lack of trading could stem from a long-term strategy, liquidity constraints, tax or compliance arrangements, or it could simply be a matter of messaging management. Based solely on static holdings, it cannot be conclusively characterized. Second, he uses historical market-cap ranges to show that the target level has not yet been reached, thereby explaining why external doubts have not changed his pace. However, this also leaves a new question: historical peak values cannot be extrapolated linearly. Liquidity, narrative rotations, and the regulatory environment may differ this time. If high conviction is paired with insufficient transparent disclosure, it may instead intensify suspicion during amplified volatility.

The path of impact on the crypto market is more emotional and structural than directional certainty. If high-attention addresses continue to repeatedly state they will not sell, in the short term it could reduce some participants’ concerns about concentrated selling. Risk preference for related Meme assets and other high-volatility sectors may be steadied; but on the other side, if tokens are highly concentrated, information is not transparent, and the wording of key individuals carries too much weight, the price may become more easily driven by single statements. Once events later approach the thresholds he mentioned—if his positions change, or if on-chain flows conflict with public claims—the market will reevaluate the trust premium. Volatility could also spill over from one specific coin to speculative assets across the same ecosystem.

The editor’s assessment is that the value of this news is not to provide a buy/sell conclusion, but to highlight the “personalized risk” in Meme coin governance: when a project’s narrative, holding addresses, and social media influence are bound together, participants need to distinguish facts, positions, and marketing. The factual portion should be limited to the statements relayed by Odaily and the approximate market caps. The speculative portion must clearly mark uncertainties. A more robust way to observe is to track whether public disclosures are consistent, whether holdings are verifiable, and whether behavior near the stated thresholds matches earlier statements—rather than interpreting “not selling” as automatically clean, or packaging long-term holding as inherently safe.

可确认的事实是，Bonk Guy称自己选择长期持有高信念标的，理由来自上一轮周期的经验：部分Meme币市值曾达到10亿美元以上，强势Meme币达到40亿至50亿美元以上，优秀协议则达到50亿美元以上；他还认为本轮行情可能更加活跃。按其披露口径，目前持仓中的PONS和USELESS市值分别约为4亿美元和2.7亿美元，尚未达到10亿美元，所以选择继续持有，并强调自己拥有不同的投资时间周期。这里的核心不是“涨或跌”的即时判断，而是他把卖出条件同历史区间、信念浓度和个人周期绑定。

逻辑上，这一回应试图拆解两层误会。第一层，把“不卖出”直接等同于操纵，证据链并不完整；不交易可能源于长期策略、流动性约束、税务或合规安排，也可能是话术管理，单看持仓静止无法定性。第二层，他用历史市值区间说明目标位尚未触及，从而解释为何暂不因外部质疑改变节奏。但这也留下新的问题：历史峰值不能线性外推，本轮流动性、叙事轮换和监管环境都可能不同；高信念如果缺少透明披露，反而会在波动放大时加剧猜疑。

对加密市场的影响路径更偏向情绪与结构，而非确定方向。若高关注地址持续表达不减持，短线可能削弱部分参与者对集中抛售的担忧，相关Meme资产与同类高波动板块的风险偏好或被稳住；但另一面，筹码集中、信息不透明和关键人物言论权重过高，会使价格更容易受单次表态牵引。一旦后续接近其所称门槛、仓位出现变化，或链上流向与公开说法不一致，市场会重新评估信任溢价，波动也可能从单币种外溢到同生态的投机资产。

编辑判断是，这条新闻的价值不在于给出买卖结论，而在于提示Meme币治理中的“人格化风险”：当项目叙事、持仓地址和社交媒体影响力绑定，参与者需要区分事实、立场与营销。事实部分应限于Odaily转述的表态与约数市值；推测部分必须标明不确定性。更稳健的观察方式是跟踪公开披露是否一致、持仓是否可验证、门槛附近的行为是否与此前说法吻合，而不是把“没卖”直接解释为清白，也不把长期持有自动包装成安全。

#BTC #ETH I thought trading was a battle.
The enemy was the market—candlesticks—news—the big players.
Later I realized the true battlefield was always in my own heart.
In my heart lives a person called Xiaoming. He’s impulsive, greedy, fearful, and impatient. He always whispers in my ear: “Buy now! If you don’t, it’ll be too late and it’ll be gone to the upside!” “Sell now! The profits are about to fly!” “Add to your position—if it drops, just pretend you didn’t see it!”
I hate him. I treat him as a weakness, as shame, as impurities that must be eliminated.
I set discipline, lay down rules, and build high walls—just to imprison him.
I thought that if I destroyed Xiaoming, I could become a “perfect trader”—
calm, rational, machine-precise, desireless like a god.
But strangely, every time I think I’ve finally tamed him, he somehow returns quietly in the dead of night,
carrying familiar anxiety and longing, and gently asks me:
“Are you really happy?”
I froze.
Turns out, the one who wanted to win was him; the one who wanted to change was him; and the one unwilling to be ordinary was him too.
Without Xiaoming, I wouldn’t even be sitting in front of this screen. I wouldn’t replay my trades through countless late nights. I wouldn’t still believe in tomorrow after losses.
